io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.options

Class ItemDescriptionsOption

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.options.ItemDescriptionsOption
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SlimefunGuideOption<java.lang.Boolean>, Keyed

    public class ItemDescriptionsOption
extends java.lang.Object
implements SlimefunGuideOption<java.lang.Boolean>
    A per-player toggle for detailed item descriptions on physical items in the player's inventory. Default on; players who already know the items can switch the extra lore off. The guide item-view always shows descriptions regardless of this toggle.
